_comment: Input for external/licenses/generate.js. All third-party libraries are bundled from npm (see external/bundles.js) and found automatically. "embedded" lists third-party code that is copied inside one of those npm packages (and so has no package of its own); it is listed when its host package is bundled. "vendored" would list libraries copied into src/lib/ without npm (none).

embedded.name: zlib-streams-ts (port of zlib)
embedded.note: A TypeScript port of zlib by Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler. License text from the zlib-streams-ts 1.2.0 npm package.

embedded.name: JZlib (credit)
embedded.note: zip.js states: "This program is based on JZlib 1.0.2 ymnk, JCraft,Inc. JZlib is based on zlib-1.1.3, so all credit should go authors Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler and contributors of zlib." License text from the JZlib repository (LICENSE.txt).

embedded.name: Acorn (parts)
embedded.usedFor: Character classes used by the JavaScript beautifier (js/src/javascript/acorn.js)
embedded.note: js-beautify states: "Parts of this section of code is taken from acorn. Acorn was written by Marijn Haverbeke and released under an MIT license." License text from the acorn npm package.

embedded.name: Esprima (Unicode regular expressions)
embedded.usedFor: Unicode identifier and whitespace patterns used by the JavaScript beautifier
embedded.note: js-beautify states that its Unicode regexps "were taken from Esprima by Ariya Hidayat". License text from the esprima npm package.

embedded.name: diff-match-patch (credit)
embedded.usedFor: The diff algorithm of the side-by-side and inline diff views
embedded.note: @codemirror/merge states: "This algorithm was heavily inspired by Neil Fraser's diff-match-patch library." It is credited here as the origin of the algorithm. License text from the diff-match-patch repository (LICENSE).
